summary: Landing page for the Ansible community documentation. It reminds readers to match the docs version to their installed Ansible version and notes that Ansible ships a major release about twice a year while collections move faster.
questions: How often does Ansible put out a new major release?
How do I make sure I'm reading docs for the Ansible version I actually have installed?
Why do modules and plugins change faster than ansible-core itself?

answer_card.title: Ansible docs versions and release cadence
answer_card.answer_md:
- The docs are versioned; check the version shown in the top-left corner and pick the one matching your installed Ansible.
- New features are annotated with the Ansible version that added them.
- Ansible ships a **major release roughly twice a year**. The core evolves conservatively, while modules and plugins live in collections and change much more quickly.
